extracted.name: Peas and Pancetta
extracted.description: Peas and pancetta are pan-fried to perfection in white wine and thyme, creating a flavorful Italian-inspired side dish that will elevate any meal.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Cook and stir pancetta and onion in hot oil until pancetta is cooked and starting to crisp, about 5 minutes.
Stir in peas, wine, thyme, salt, and pepper, then bring to boil. Reduce the heat and simmer until peas are tender and liquid is slightly reduced, 3 to 5 minutes.
